experiment_data.hypothesis: BCE predictor trained at 30% target (actual sparsity collapsed to 4.2%) evaluated with forced TEAL top-k at 30%. If downstream metrics approach KL 30% level, BCE's prediction quality is adequate when allocation is externally enforced; if not, KL's mask patterns are genuinely superior even with matched allocation.
